title: Lever Action Rifles Re-Animated!
description: Turns crossbows into animated heavily detailed lever-action rifles!
body:
# ---**ANIMATED LEVER ACTION RIFLES RE-ANIMATED**---

**Turns crossbows into animated heavily detailed lever-action rifles with custom arm texture support!**
## INCLUDED FEATURES 
- Custom Sneak and offhanded sneak model
- Custom Pulling and offhand pulling animations
- Cool aim down sights perspective while pulled !

 
--**How To Change Arm Textures**--
1. Properly un-zip the recourcepack
2. Navigate and find the **"**item**"** folder inside the **"**textures**"** folder
3. find and delete the **"**skin.png**"**
4. Put your skin in and rename it to **"**skin.png**"**
5. Properly Re-Zip the recourcepack
 
(Comes built-in with the default Alex Skin's arms)

(supports higher resolution skins)

**WORKS WITH SLIM SKINS ONLY** (for now)

**OFFHAND AND MAINHAND WILL BE REVERSED IN   "Main Hand: Left"   MODE**


Heavily inspired/Modelled after the **Marlin Firearms Dark Series Model 336**
